title: [0.98a] Halo Dynamics Ship Industry 1.7.0 [2025/7/12] - EN Edition
author: persocom01
contentHtml:
Halo Dynamics Ship Industry

Original mod by Ajimu, Contentment, Scythe (Original Fossic post)
Translated by persocom01

Download: Github

Requires LazyLib, GraphicsLib, MagicLib, LunaLib
Integrated with Nexerelin

Formerly the Domain Alien Technology Research Institute, Halo Dynamics possesses a considerable number of alien artifacts and reverse-engineered technologies. Following the Collapse, the base Council, supported by its garrison fleet, weathered the initial chaos, consolidated control over neighboring star systems, and began mass-producing new warships based on alien technology. Numerous designs that could not be mass produced during the Domain era for various reasons were deployed in combat, allowing Halo Dynamics to dominate their home sector. After decisively crushing the Tri-Tachyon local branch, Halo Dynamics' advance fleet traced Tri-Tachyon's hyperwave transmissions and arrived in the Persean Sector via EHOF.

Halo Dynamics occupies the Intrusion system directly south of Corvus.

— Campaign Mission —
Peace Mission — can Halo Dynamics and Tri-Tachyon put their long-standing feud to rest? If you have good standing with both Halo Dynamics and the Director, visit the bar on Culann when this mission appears to find out! This mission will always eventually appear on the intel screen, but the bar event required to continue the questline will only trigger if you meet the conditions. This mission is time sensitive and can be missed.

— Halo System —
A unique shield system used by Halo Dynamics ships that operates independently from flux capacity. It allows Halo Dynamics ships to absorb damage at minimal flux cost, at the expense of poorer recovery compared to traditional shields. Ideal for alpha strikes that ignore flux cost in favor of overwhelming firepower.

— Halo Dynamics Ship Industry —
The shipbuilding department of Halo Dynamics and its most commonly used public-facing identity, Halo Dynamics Ship Industry is responsible for the construction of all Halo Dynamics ships and the majority of ship design. However, precision engineering is not their strong suit, and tactical and weapons systems require collaboration with the Weapons Industry and the Department of Science and Technology.

— Halo Dynamics Weapons Industry —
The manufacturer of all standardized Halo Dynamics weaponry, their designs are basic but reliable, unlike those from the Department of Science and Technology. They also offer modifications of certain Domain era weapons.

— Halo Dynamics Department of Science and Technology —
The department responsible for reverse engineering alien technology and cutting edge technological development. Unlike the Weapons Industry, their proposed designs often give members of the council headaches. These systems often yield extraordinary results, at the cost of equally extreme flux cost.

— The Director? —
The leader of Halo Dynamics. Rumor has it that she was already the director of the Institute before the Collapse. If true, this would make her over 250 years old. Perhaps your paths may cross someday.
[Full questline WIP]

— H.P.S.I.D —
The Security and Intelligence Department maintains several contacts in Wanderer. By submitting rare artifacts and survey data, you can improve relations with Halo Dynamics, earn rewards, and unlock long-term benefits — provided you remain a friend of Halo Dynamics.

— Contact Network —
There is talk that suggests that you can dial 599267737 via Tripad for early access.

— Disclaimer —
Halo Dynamics assumes no responsibility for any confusion or disappointment arising from the mistaken belief that it is affiliated with or related to the Halo franchise.

Known issues:
Spoiler
The Ship and Weapons Industry Representative contact has no mission. Do not develop him.
Weapons changing to Halo Dynamics variants can be restored by putting them in your inventory and closing the refit screen.
3rd Guards fleets will check your transponder in hyperspace.
Space Bridge will spawn 3rd Guards fleet for the faction that owns it when taken over.
The Liebe Superheavy Railgun does not autofire if it is the only weapon on a ship.
Small Wingman may not function with Advanced Gunnery Control.
Game crashes when equipping the Ukiyo if weapons were previously equipped before changing ship mode. Recommend stripping the ship before equipping.
